integrity: Theorems proved for every R>0 by explicit Hermite ambiguity identities and calculus; numerical tests corroborate but do not replace the proof. No experimental claim of optimal nonlinear phase retrieval is made.
limitations: The sharp lower singular value concerns the unrestricted linear two-channel ambiguity-multiplication map on a fixed disk, not the nonlinear phase-retrieval map on physical signal pairs. The window set and total precision budget are fixed; priority is best-knowledge rather than independent certification.
title: Sharp diskwise ambiguity conditioning for the first two Hermite windows
